Questions

Before you ask

The essentials, answered straight.

How do I receive the kit after buying?

Checkout happens on Whop. After payment, the kit is delivered to your Whop account, where you can download it any time — one file containing the guide, tracker, checklist, and routines.

I'm a complete beginner. Is this too advanced for me?

No — the kit was built for beginners. The Getting Started Guide assumes no prior airdrop experience and walks you through wallet setup and your first project step by step.

How much money do I need to start farming airdrops?

Many airdrop tasks are free (testnets, social tasks, Galxe/Zealy quests). For mainnet activity you'll typically want a small budget for gas fees. The guide explains how to start lean and scale only when it makes sense.

Does this kit guarantee I'll receive airdrops?

No, and be wary of anyone who promises that. Airdrops depend on each project's own criteria. What the kit does is maximize your organization, consistency, and safety — the parts that are actually in your control.

Is this a subscription?

No. It's a single $20 payment. You download the files and keep them forever.
